title: The gate
hints: Remember the instruction from the lesson? You need to move your wizard.
You only need one instruction to take a step towards the gate.
intro: We are one step away from the gate! Let's write our very first program to walk up to it. It won't open yet, but we must start at the beginning!
outro: Great! You have learned to move your wizard. Now let's see how we get through this gate.
learned: Now you know what a program and an instruction are, and the instruction that moves your wizard.
